description: React component for an emoji picker interface, including search, categories, navigation, and custom emoji support.

methods.name: getInitialActiveCategory
methods.description: Determines initial active category based on recent emojis.

methods.name: getInitialCategories
methods.description: Initial categories setup, including recent emojis if available.

methods.name: getEmojiById
methods.description: Retrieves emoji object by its ID, case-insensitive.

methods.name: selectFirstEmoji
methods.description: Selects the first emoji in the current emoji positions list.

methods.name: handleCategoryClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a category, updates active category and cursor.

methods.name: resetCursor
methods.description: Resets emoji cursor to initial state.

methods.name: onAddCustomEmojiClickInner
methods.description: Handles adding a custom emoji, closes picker and triggers callback.

methods.name: calculateNewCursorForUpArrow
methods.description: Calculates new cursor position when navigating up with arrow keys.

methods.name: calculateNewCursorForRightOrLeftArrow
methods.description: Calculates new cursor position when navigating left/right with arrow keys.

methods.name: calculateNewCursorForDownArrow
methods.description: Calculates new cursor position when navigating down with arrow keys.

methods.name: handleKeyboardEmojiNavigation
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation for emoji selection.

methods.name: handleEnterOnEmoji
methods.description: Handles pressing Enter on selected emoji.

methods.name: handleEmojiOnMouseOver
methods.description: Updates cursor when mouse hovers over an emoji.
